# Intermediate Projects

Scale complexity only after the learner can explain prerequisites and validate
the results. Use authorized or clearly labeled synthetic data.

## Customer segmentation

- Define a business objective and customer grain.
- Clean and explore features; compare a simple segmentation baseline with a
  suitable clustering approach.
- Explain assumptions, segment stability, and limitations.

## Sales forecasting

- Establish a naive baseline and time-based validation split.
- Compare an appropriate forecasting approach and metrics.
- Explain seasonality, uncertainty, leakage risk, and business use.

## ETL pipeline

- Ingest sample data, validate a schema, transform, and persist outputs.
- Test idempotency, retries, duplicate handling, and data quality.
- Document lineage, monitoring, and failure recovery.

## BI dashboard

- Define audience, KPIs, data grain, and metric definitions.
- Build a model and dashboard in the requested BI tool.
- Validate calculations and explain design decisions.

## PySpark transformation

- Process a sufficiently structured sample dataset.
- Explain transformations versus actions, partitioning, and shuffle behavior.
- Validate output and compare performance only when measured.

## Statistical experiment

- Define hypothesis, outcome, population, design, and sample-size rationale.
- Analyze an example with assumptions and uncertainty.
- Distinguish statistical significance from practical impact and causality.
